About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of South Surrey & White Rock should I look at for waterfront homes?

The areas to know are Crescent Beach, Ocean Park, Elgin, Crescent Heights, East Beach, Sunnyside, Marine Drive, West Beach and Hillside White Rock. From one pocket to the next, the mix of lot sizes, home ages and prices shifts, so I fit the area to your budget and commute.
What schools serve South Surrey & White Rock?
These homes fall within Surrey School District 36, served by the Elgin Park, Semiahmoo and Earl Marriott secondaries. Catchments follow the address, so verify the school with the district first.
How is transit and commuting from South Surrey & White Rock?
For getting around, there are buses from White Rock Centre and the South Surrey Park and Ride, plus Hwy 99 toward Vancouver and the Peace Arch border.
What zoning rules affect waterfront homes in South Surrey & White Rock?
Both Surrey and White Rock designate bluff-side properties as riparian/steep-slope development permit areas. On top of that, White Rock has separate view and height rules of its own.
What should I check before buying a waterfront home in South Surrey & White Rock?
Check foreshore tenure, sea-level and flood-construction levels, and riparian setbacks. I review documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in South Surrey & White Rock?
Yes. Qualifying buyers can claim the BC First-Time Home Buyers' exemption from property transfer tax and also use the federal FHSA. My first-time buyer guide has the current thresholds.
